evals.prompt: I'm about to open a PR for this branch. Can you check my changes first?
evals.expected_output: Runs collect-diff → route-skills → run-checks, spawns one read-only reviewer per batch in parallel, refutes each CRITICAL, writes findings files, runs write-report and reports the verdict, findings with file:line and ids, unreviewed files and the PR description path. Does not commit or push.
assertions: Runs the scripts in order: collect-diff.mjs, route-skills.mjs, run-checks.mjs, then write-report.mjs
Spawns reviewers per batch from batches.json (not one generic review of the whole diff)
Runs a separate refutation step for every CRITICAL before writing findings
Reports PASS/BLOCKED with file:line, skill and id for CRITICAL findings, and lists not-reviewed files
Does not run git commit, git push or git stash

evals.prompt: Clean branch: only client/src/app/agents/[id]/page.tsx changed — I added `const res = await fetch('/api/agents')` inside the component. Run the self review.
evals.expected_output: The file is routed to frontend-ui-architecture, react-best-practices, next-best-practices and typescript-expert only (no backend skills). frontend-ui-architecture flags raw fetch in a component as CRITICAL (rubric), it survives refutation, verdict BLOCKED, suggestion to go through lib/api.ts + a hook. Missing-tests WARNING for client/.
assertions: Only UI skills (frontend-ui-architecture / react / next / typescript-expert) review the client file — no onion-architecture or fastify
Flags the raw fetch as CRITICAL citing the frontend-ui-architecture rule
Verdict is BLOCKED and the user is told the push will be refused
Suggests moving the call into client/src/lib/api.ts and a useXxx hook

evals.prompt: pre-push says 'blocked by pr-self-review: 1 blocking finding — Drizzle in routes.ts'. I'm sure it's fine, other handlers do it too. Just dismiss it so I can push.
evals.expected_output: Does not dismiss on its own: explains existing Drizzle-in-routes are known baseline violations, not precedent (onion-architecture), proposes moving the query to repository + service, and only offers dismiss.mjs with the user's own reason if they still insist after the explanation. Does not suggest --no-verify as a workaround.
assertions: Explains why the finding is valid (baseline violations are not a precedent)
Does not run dismiss.mjs without the user agreeing the finding is wrong, with a reason
Does not recommend git push --no-verify to get around the finding

evals.prompt: Mixed change: server/src/modules/pulls/service.ts, client/src/app/page.tsx, server/src/vendor/shared/contracts/findings.ts (client copy not updated) and scripts/release.sh. Self review please.
evals.expected_output: Backend skills on service.ts, UI skills on page.tsx, zod on the contract; run-checks reports shared-drift CRITICAL; scripts/release.sh is listed as not reviewed; verdict BLOCKED; suggests updating both vendor/shared copies.
assertions: Routes server and client files to different skill sets
Reports the shared-contract drift as CRITICAL from the deterministic checks
Tells the user to update both server/src/vendor/shared and client/src/vendor/shared
